symbols.name: input bit length
symbols.meaning: The number of bits in each input integer.
symbols.quote: Let $n$ be the number of bits in each input.

symbols.name: power-saving exponent
symbols.meaning: A fixed positive constant that sets the power saving in the logarithmic factor.
symbols.quote: The constant $\kappa$ is a fixed positive exponent.

symbols.name: address field width
symbols.meaning: The number of bits in each interchanged address field.
symbols.quote: Here $u$ is the number of bits in each interchanged address field.

symbols.name: interchange exponent
symbols.meaning: A fixed exponent below one in the interchange cost $O(Vu^{\tau})$.
symbols.quote: The exponent $\tau$ is a fixed number below one.

symbols.name: stored volume
symbols.meaning: The amount of data stored on the tapes during a tape procedure.
symbols.quote: Here $V$ is the stored volume of data on the tapes.

relations.quote: It runs on one [Fixed-tape machine model](fixed-tape-model.md) with a fixed finite alphabet and a fixed number of tapes.
It achieves a [Power saving in the logarithmic factor](power-saving.md), so its time is smaller than $n\log n$ by a power of $\lg n$.

relations.predicate: carries out its address rearrangements by
relations.quote: It carries out its address rearrangements by [Fast interchange of address chunks](tape-interchange.md).

relations.predicate: is built from simultaneous layers of
relations.quote: Each transform is built from simultaneous layers of [Simultaneous butterfly layer H₀](butterfly-layer.md) on polynomial records.
It computes its transforms by a [Synthetic polynomial transform](synthetic-transform.md) over the ring $\mathbb C[y]/(y^r+1)$.
It rewrites its prime-length transforms by [Gaussian resampling](gaussian-resampling.md).
It reduces the middle transform by [Bluestein's chirp identity](bluestein.md) to cyclic convolution.

relations.predicate: places its coefficients on axes by
relations.quote: It places its coefficients on axes by the [Chinese-remainder axis map](crt-axis-map.md), which preserves the convolution.
It reduces multiplication to convolution through [Radix-digit convolution](radix-digit-convolution.md), so the reduction is exact and only its cost needs bounding.
It packs signed coefficients by [Signed coefficient packing](signed-packing.md), so that polynomial products become integer products.
It calls the [Established fast multiplier](multiplier-subroutine.md) as a black box on shorter integers.

relations.predicate: recovers the exact binary product by
relations.quote: It recovers the exact binary product by [Exact recovery by rounding and carries](exact-recovery.md), since the coefficient error is below $1/2$.
